items.name: The Les Baguettes Classic
items.description: A classic that everyone knows and loves. Crispy and decadent freshly baked World's Best French-style Nordic Baguette with thinly sliced smoked ham and rich, creamy butter from local farms.

items.name: The Chic Parm Club
items.description: A delicious, tender and crispy chicken breast breaded and deepfried, topped with mozzarella and marinara sauce, stuffed between our chic club sandwich and toasted until perfection! Comes with a marinara dipping sauce because there can never be too much sauce!

items.name: The Victorious Vegetal
items.description: For our vegan friends, A crispy and decadent freshly baked World's Best French-style Nordic Baguette stuffed with our marinated mushrooms, roasted peppers and grilled zucchini. Topped off with fresh greens, cucumber and tomato slices.

items.name: The Spectacular Seafood Shanty
items.description: Our most luxurious sandwich for the special moments in life. Two slices of our traditional sourdough bread, toasted to perfection and topped with a thin layer of rich and decadent cream cheese, cold-smoked salmon, a dollop of crème fraîche, and caviar to top it off. Garnished with dill and chives.

items.name: The Sweet Dreams Are Made of Cheese
items.description: Our newest contender on the list, and the sweetest. A crispy and decadent freshly baked World's Best French-style Nordic Baguette stuffed with four types of cheese (Mozzarella, Fontina, Provolone and Parmiggiano Reggiano), toasted until perfection and served with some arugula and a sweet balsamic glaze to tie everything together.

items.name: The Mighty Mozzarella
items.description: Six delicious Mozzarella sticks served with Marinara dipping sauce

items.name: The Tender Chick
items.description: Six Chicken Tenders served with a mayonnaise of your choice (Garlic, Chipotle, Curry, Paprika, Remoulade, Les Baguettes Special)

items.name: The veggie vat
items.description: A classic salad with mixed vegetables and a House-made salad dressing.

items.name: Soda
items.description: A 0.5L soda of your choice (coca-cola, fanta, sprite, mountain dew, orangina, jaffa)

items.name: The OJ
items.description: A 0.5L glass of freshly squeezed orange juice

items.name: The eau de bubbles luxe
items.description: Luxurious sparkling water infused with an organic lemon taste. The water is sourced from the sacred Montagne de Baguette.

items.name: The Classic Croissant
items.description: A Scrumptious classic croissant, nothing less, nothing more.

items.name: The Crookie Concoction
items.description: Our newest product, perhaps a blasphemous creation. A combination of a cookie and a croissant for the sweet-lovers.

items.name: The Big Crunch
items.description: A fan-favourite classic chocolate chip cookie, topped with flaky sea salt.

items.name: The Big Apple
items.description: A New York style cheesecake, topped with some apple compote.
